text: The packaged demo now runs two separate Keycloak browser logins. Its steward finds a person in the other lab by display name, grants metadata on one exact Matching Pennies release, then revokes it. The recipient has no dataset-head access. The rehearsal checks an incomplete callback, the protected cookie, deep-link return, the CSRF requirement and server logout. Run scripts/check-demo-instance.sh. Institutional provider registration and the broader F04 pilot gates remain open.
